description: Quantify cavity-to-cavity fill imbalance from short-shot weights. Give two or more replicate shots at a fill level and the result also says whether the variation comes from the cavities (runner and gate geometry) or from shot-to-shot process drift — the two have opposite fixes. Judge balance on a short shot at 90% fill or above.

levels.description: One entry per fill percentage tested — e.g. a 50%, then a 95%, short shot.

shots.description: One entry per shot, mapping cavity name to part weight in grams

study_code.description: A study as the Lab card encodes it; use instead of the measurements (levels)

name: cavity_balance
title: Cavity balance study
